strategy.base_map_anchor: Survey of India base maps and district planning maps
strategy.statutory_priority: Survey of India first, then local cadastral and land-record layers

nrsc_isro_bhuvan.verified_source_note: NRSC's Urban and Infrastructure Bhuvan Services page lists National Urban Information System, urban growth monitoring, master-plan formulation, heritage/monument services, census geospatial representation, and other urban/infrastructure thematic services.
nrsc_isro_bhuvan.access_notes: Public viewer and thematic portals; downloads or collaboration workflows may require Bhuvan registration or project-specific access.

survey_of_india.verified_source_note: Survey of India's District Planning Map Series page lists district map names with free-download links and sits under the Maps & Data navigation.
survey_of_india.access_notes: Use for authoritative base mapping; some map products are free downloads while other datasets may require portal access or licensing.

iudx.verified_source_note: IUDX's platform page describes a secure, controlled data-sharing platform for Indian cities, created through Smart Cities Mission and MoHUA work with IISc and operated by an IISc-based team.
iudx.access_notes: Discover datasets through the exchange/catalogue; access level varies by provider and may require registration, authorization, or provider approval.

greater_chennai_corporation_gis.authority: Greater Chennai Corporation / Chennai Smart City
greater_chennai_corporation_gis.access_notes: Public pages exist; detailed GIS application access may require account credentials.

mcgm_geoportal.role: municipal GIS, development plan, property and zoning context
mcgm_geoportal.access_notes: Verify current access and download terms before statutory use.

bbmp_geoportal.role: municipal GIS, wards, planning and local service layers
bbmp_geoportal.access_notes: Verify current portal availability and dataset licensing.

hmda_gis.role: master plan, ORR zoning, metropolitan planning context
hmda_gis.access_notes: Use for planning context; verify current authoritative download access before production use.
